lessons_used: Interactive flow additions were the most effective changes, winning up to +14.8% and often exceeding predictions, though later tests showed no clear effect when overpredicted (+14.8% predicted vs +3.3% measured).
Reordering onboarding flow steps produced major wins (up to +12.0%), but carries severe downside risks (down to -8.9%) and frequently showed no clear effect.
Targeted copy updates yielded wins for account persistence notices (+3.5%) and launch buttons (+6.7%), though most other copy changes showed no clear effect.
Interactive waiting screen features produced one significant win (+3.9%), but mostly showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns failed to produce any wins, performed worse than predicted, and frequently caused severe performance drops (down to -19.3%).
Hints, notifications, layout changes, and standalone preview screens yielded no wins, with hints sometimes hurting performance (-3.1%) and the rest showing no clear effect.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Routine Sandbox Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive routine sandbox to the final onboarding step where users can test feeding, sleeping, and moving the pet before launching to desktop.
candidates.why: Finish step has a median duration of 395s and 5815s mean, while support receives emails asking how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Practice Caring for Your Desktop Pet
home_intro.body: Try feeding, calling, and guiding your pet in this interactive sandbox before sending it to your desktop.

guard.reason: Valid interactive sandbox flow added to home intro within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Interactive flows are highly effective on finish step, supported by funnel duration and direct support feedback.

candidates.title: Account Restoration Sign-In Explanation Copy
candidates.change: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly assure returning users that signing in restores existing pets and prevents account duplication.
candidates.why: Support mailbox received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account recovery communication critical.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Keep & Restore Your Pets
sign_in.body: Signing in connects your pet safely to your account so you never lose progress, even when logging in on new devices.
sign_in.hint: Already have an account? Sign in with the same email to restore your existing pets instantly.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Emotion Sound Board Flow
candidates.change: Integrates an interactive pet emotion sound board into the waiting screen, allowing users to test pet sound cues and reactions while setup finishes.
candidates.why: Home waiting screen takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, creating high drop-off during background generation.

waiting.headline: Your Pet is Getting Ready!
waiting.body: Tap the sound buttons below to hear your pet's vocalizations while we initialize its animations.

guard.reason: Valid waiting screen enhancement that continues to inform the user the pet is being prepared.

candidates.score_note: Interactive flow additions during home setup step consistently drive positive engagement during long waits.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Personality Quiz Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a short, interactive personality quiz screen right before adoption certificate to let users pick active, calm, or curious pet dispositions.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 71.2% conversion rate and 89s median completion time; adding interactive selection builds personal attachment and clarity.

new_personality_quiz.headline: What is Your Pet's Personality?
new_personality_quiz.body: Select disposition traits that determine how your desktop companion reacts and plays throughout the day.

guard.reason: Valid insertion of a new personality quiz screen into the onboarding sequence.

candidates.score_note: Adding standalone screens historically underperforms and risks reducing conversion despite adoption drop-off.

candidates.title: Reorder Story Sequence After Path Choice
candidates.change: Moves the introductory story screen to follow path choice, letting users choose their initial journey path immediately upon opening the app.
candidates.why: Choose path screen has an 8s median time but 514s mean time, suggesting users want immediate action before long background stories.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.change: Adds explicit instructions and hint copy to the home intro screen detailing how to summon, minimize, and access pet controls via system tray.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Companion is Ready!

home_intro.hint: Shortcut: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to instantly bring your pet to the front of your desktop.

guard.reason: Valid copy update providing guidance on the home intro overlay.

candidates.score_note: Targeted copy changes resolving explicit support emails yield low-cost, consistent positive results.

candidates.title: Photo Processing Safety and Retry Indicator
candidates.change: Provides real-time feedback and photo processing status on the photo upload screen to prevent silent failures during custom pet generation.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation failing or rendering incorrectly during the photo step.

upload_photos.hint: For best results, upload clear photos with distinct contrast against the background.

guard.reason: Valid progress feedback added to the photo upload screen.

candidates.score_note: Status feedback addresses direct support complaints on high-loss adoption step with moderate effort.

lessons_next: Interactive flow additions produced the largest wins (up to +14.8%), though predictions were sometimes too optimistic as recent flow tests caused severe drops (down to -10.2%).
Step reordering generated strong wins (up to +12.0%), but carries high risk, frequently failing, showing no clear effect, or causing significant negative impacts (down to -8.9%).
Wait-state indicators produced solid wins (up to +6.1%), sometimes exceeding predictions (+6.1% vs +3.2% predicted), though others showed no clear effect.
Targeted copy updates achieved selective wins (+3.5% and +6.7%), but follow-up copy tweaks showed no clear effect.

UI redesigns, layout changes, standalone preview screens, hints, and notifications failed to produce any wins, with redesigns (down to -19.3%) and hints (down to -3.1%) often causing significant performance declines.
